items.title: 6.3.3 Enthalpy change of formation (formation ki enthalpy change) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.3.3, printed page 121.

blocks.title: Enthalpy change of formation
blocks.text: Kisi compound ki standard enthalpy change of formation woh enthalpy change hai jo tab hoti hai jab us compound ka ek mole apne elements se standard conditions par banta hai.
Yeh exothermic bhi ho sakti hai aur endothermic bhi. Misal ke taur par methane ki ΔH°f neeche di gai hai.

blocks.prompt: C₂H₄ ki standard enthalpy of formation kaun si equation dikhati hai: 2C(diamond) + 2H₂ → C₂H₄ ya 2C(graphite) + 2H₂ → C₂H₄?
blocks.explanation: Graphite wali. Formation ki definition (tareef) mein elements apni standard state mein hote hain, aur carbon ki standard state graphite hai, diamond nahi; saath hi compound ka ek mole banna chahiye.

items: ΔH°f: elements (standard state) se compound ka ek mole banna; exothermic ya endothermic ho sakti hai (methane –74.8 kJ mol⁻¹).
